name: – Joachim Stanisław Brudziński – After § 9 – Am 3
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section X – European External Action Service
part_text: 9 a. Calls for the end of Union funding to UNRWA, in light of allegations regarding the involvement of its staff in the October 2023 Hamas terrorist attack against Israel; firmly asserts that the European Union must not channel any taxpayer money to organizations suspected of collaboration or complicity with terrorist groups;
